hero.name: Mikaelle Nascimento
hero.title: Data Analysis & Fraud Prevention
hero.tagline: Fraud Prevention Analyst at PicPay. I work with high-volume transactional data extraction and analysis, SQL investigation and dashboards to turn evidence into decisions. Currently studying Statistics and Data Science at UFES.

experienceSection.headline: Professional Experience
experienceSection.description: From commercial roles to data analysis in fintech, with a constant focus on evidence and results.

highlights: Extraction and analysis of high-volume transactional data to identify discrepancies, suspicious behaviour and risk patterns
Built SQL queries for alert investigation, cross-referencing registration and transactional data from multiple sources
Developed and maintained a personal Tableau dashboard for performance indicator tracking
Handled ticket-based demands, prioritising cases by deadline, criticality and impact
Produced reports and investigation documentation, keeping analyses traceable for audit
Reviewed approvals and blocks generated by automated systems (double-check), supporting decision quality
Prospecting, activation and management of a B2B client portfolio in the automotive sector, tracking funnel indicators
Relationship management, negotiation and technical-commercial support, developing business acumen and a results orientation
Continuous improvement initiative recognised internally with 2nd place in the Panorama Lean programme

achievementsSection.headline: Key Deliverables
achievementsSection.description: Initiatives where data analysis, automation and business insight produced practical results.

achievements.title: Performance Dashboard in Tableau
achievements.summary: Developed and maintained a personal Tableau dashboard for tracking performance indicators.
achievements.impact: Continuous indicator visibility, replacing manual tracking with centralised visualisation
details: Modelled the relevant indicators from transactional data
Built the visualisations and maintained the dashboard over time
Used the dashboard as the basis for performance tracking and prioritisation

achievements.title: Alert Investigation with SQL
achievements.summary: Built SQL queries for alert investigation, cross-referencing registration and transactional data from different sources.
achievements.impact: Traceable, documented analyses that support decisions with evidence
details: Cross-referenced separate databases to reconstruct the full context of each alert
Identified discrepancies and risk patterns across high transaction volumes
Documented investigations keeping analyses traceable for audit
Reviewed automated decisions (double-check) to raise output quality

achievements.title: Automation Recognised in Lean Programme
achievements.summary: A continuous improvement initiative built independently, starting from a pain point identified in the daily workflow.
achievements.impact: 2nd place in Panorama Lean, the company's internal continuous improvement programme
details: Identified an automation opportunity within the team's workflow
Built and implemented the solution end to end
Presented the result in the internal continuous improvement programme

achievements.title: Statistics and Data Science Degree
achievements.summary: Admitted to UFES via external transfer for the BSc in Statistics and Data Science, after 4 semesters in Software Engineering.
achievements.impact: Formal statistical grounding combined with hands-on fintech data experience
details: Approved in the external transfer process to the Federal University of Espírito Santo
Credit transfer from prior coursework in Software Engineering
Participant in the Google Student Ambassadors Programme, focused on Artificial Intelligence
